faq: How much does ElevenLabs cost?

Free is $0 with 10,000 credits a month. Starter is $6/month ($5/month billed yearly) for 30,000 credits, Creator $22/month ($18.33 yearly) for 121,000, Pro $99/month ($82.50 yearly) for 600,000, Scale $299/month ($249.17 yearly) for 1,800,000 and Business $990/month ($825 yearly) for 6,000,000. Enterprise is custom.
How many credits does text to speech use?

On the highest quality models 1 text character costs 1 credit, and one minute of audio is about 1,000 characters. On the Flash and Turbo models, API usage costs between 0.5 and 1 credit per character.
Do unused credits roll over?

On paid plans, unused credits roll over for up to two months, so your balance can reach 3 times your monthly quota while you keep an active subscription. Downgrading or cancelling forfeits them at the end of the cycle, and the Free plan has no rollover.
Is yearly billing cheaper?

Yes. Yearly billing works out to two months free, since you pay 10 months' price for 12. The monthly equivalent is $5 on Starter, $18.33 on Creator, $82.50 on Pro, $249.17 on Scale and $825 on Business.

faq: How is {tool} API usage metered?
Text to speech is billed per character, speech to text per audio minute, music and sound effects per generation, and dubbing per minute of source audio.
What do the speech to text extras cost?

On Scribe v3, v2 and v2 Medical, keyterm prompting costs $0.05 per hour and transcript editing $0.07 per hour. On Scribe v3 Live and v2 Realtime, keyterm prompting is $0.08 per hour, the keyterm library (Scribe v3 Live only) $0.08 and transcript editing $0.12.
What does the {tool} Realtime API cost in tokens?

On top of the per-minute price, Realtime v1 Mini costs $0.20 per 1M input tokens and $6.00 per 1M output tokens, and Realtime v1 Max $1.80 and $9.00. Connected audio above your concurrency limit is billed at a burst price of $0.16 per minute.
Can I use custom voices through the API?
Yes. You can use any voice in your library by its ID, including cloned, professional and designed voices.
What happens to unused API usage if I change plans?

After an upgrade, unused credits roll over into the next billing cycle. After a downgrade or cancellation, the plan stays active until the end of the cycle, then the account moves to Free and unused paid credits expire.
